title: Accessible API Onboarding: contrast-friendly code cards & stream-aware visuals
creator: Maya Alvarez
description: Design a small set of high-contrast, accessibility-first onboarding visual assets for the API/SDK quickstart docs. Deliverables: a modular set of code-card components (light/dark, high-contrast) that clearly show auth flows (API key, OAuth device flow, and service account), a streaming response tile with keyboard-friendly controls and focus states, and a compact tool-calling sequence that can be embedded as three progressive screenshots or an animated GIF. These assets will be used across the quickstart pages and the console first-run experience. Aim for minimal copy, large monospaced code areas, visible success/failure states, and explicit aria/keyboard interaction notes for engineers implementing the UI. Keep file sizes optimized for docs and create PNG/JPEG screenshots plus one optimized animated WebP for the toolcall flow.
acceptance_criteria: Three code-card variants produced: API key, OAuth device flow, service account; each in light, dark, and high-contrast palettes
Streaming tile with clear play/pause, live token indicator, and keyboard focus outlines; includes 3 annotated states (idle, streaming, error)
Tool-calling sequence exported as three static PNGs and one animated WebP under 1MB total
Figma file with componentized tokens and exported slices; handoff notes include aria attributes and copy for accessibility
Assets uploaded to Drive and referenced in quickstart docs PR; design sign-off from PM and accessibility review completed
